column1: # Key of the type A cipher of the Hanoverian envoys at Regensburg, 1730 (Diede and Reck; NLA Hannover, Hann. 9g Nr. 1687 and
# Hann. 92 Nr. 1149/1), rebuilt by Brice Dudout (Claude Opus 5.5 agents), 11 Nov 2026.
# Licence: CC BY 4.0, Brice Dudout (the key table as rebuilt here; the plaintext it was learned from is the chancery's own, of 1730).
# Homophonic substitution of German letters (2-4 digit groups 5-1497 separated by dots, about 1 group per letter), with a few
# word codes (seen: Chur Mayntz, Chur Cölln; 281, 26, 279 on Nr. 1149/1 aufn 0003 are codes or values not in this table).
# Learned by EM letter alignment (frozen/1687/scripts/lalign2.py) of the cipher of Relat. 16 (Nr. 1687 aufn 060-065) with the
# contemporary clear text of its P.S. (aufn 065R-068L; frozen/1687/UNITS-PS16.tsv, transcr/CLAIR-PS16.txt).
# Frozen as frozen/1687/KEY.tsv (SHA-256 4d83b4f794e64e55...e0d8df); this file is the same table with English labels.
# status: sure = n >= 3 and agreement >= 0.80; probable = n >= 2 and agreement >= 0.67, or n = 1; doubtful = otherwise.
# Doubtful rows were NOT used in either measurement (validation.txt). "·" = null. n = alignments seen; agreement = share
# of those alignments giving this value.
